project_scope: Only the owner-selected synthetic commerce fixture; PerdeOS excluded.

steps.method: Claude ran `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` in the disposable clone and recorded E2 LOCAL, PASS at the exact source HEAD. The first record's method field was a mapping and failed Core schema validation; Claude corrected only that field to the required string. The Core validator then returned ok=true, errors=[], ids_seen=11.
steps.limitations: Same Claude session as producer and verifier; explicitly non-independent; no CI/production/gate/human-approval claim.

permission_boundaries.claude: Ephemeral sessions, no session persistence; first authoring used Read/Write/Bash with a single unittest invocation preapproved; reverse review was Read+Bash only.
permission_boundaries.codex: Ephemeral; first consumption sandbox=read-only; continuation sandbox=workspace-write inside the disposable clone only.
permission_boundaries.external_data: Only synthetic fixture files, the two EVD records, and the eight test files were exposed; no actual customer/project data.

limitations: This is a minimal CLI portability sample, not a full skill-routed adapter workflow.

A standalone attempt to run run_acceptance.py in the flattened clone hit its known TARGET.parents[2] layout assumption; a direct later run reproduced IndexError before assertions. No acceptance result is inferred from that attempt.

The initial Claude response described an exit code before any Bash command had been approved/executed; the command outcome was independently reproduced afterwards. This is recorded as an execution-provenance concern, not accepted as live command evidence.
EVD-12 and EVD-13 exist only as durable snapshots in evaluation/fixtures/phase-g-handoff; the active synthetic commerce fixture was not modified.
